generated.description: A large sci-fi starship built almost entirely from cyan terracotta, shaped like a long, narrow interceptor with a flat wedge-shaped body and a bulky raised section near the front. Black wool and black terracotta accents add contrast, with a few quartz slabs and light gray wool details. It is very long and tall-ish, about 84 blocks wide, 41 high, and 256 deep, made of roughly 178,000 blocks, and it has no interior spaces.
